name: Westlake Village Community Foundation Board Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the
  Westlake Village Community Foundation

  Westlake Village City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  City Hall Conference Room
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  TUESDAY, JULY 28, 2026 - 4:00 p.m.

Written Public Comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later
than 9:00 a.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to the Committee.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the Committee Members less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are
available for public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during
normal business hours and are posted on the City’s Website: www.wlv.org/foundation
 CALL TO ORDER:  4:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Foundation Board Members Brutzkus, Croner, Vice Chair
  Halpern and Chair McSweeney

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the Westlake Village Community Foundation Board Members on items
not on this printed agenda by attending this in-person meeting or by email comments as outlined on Page
1 of the agenda.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Approval of the April 21, 2026 Minutes

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

1.  Appointment of a New Board Member - Appoint Westlake Village City
  Councilmember Ned E. Davis

2.  2026 High School Scholarships Update – Receive a report on the presentations
  from the High School Senior Awards Events.

3.  City Celebration Event – October 10, 2026 – Receive a presentation on event
  and fundraising for the Foundation.

4.  Financial Update

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, July 23, 2026 at 6:30 pm. on the City website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  7/23/2026
  City Clerk

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas
 or www.wlv.org/agendacenter or https://www.wlv.org/AgendaCenter/Westlake-Village-
 Community-Foundation-12
